Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -55.68% and SPAL is a TRIM at -36.82%. Both are leveraged and decay, making them risky. SMH is also a TRIM at -12.53%.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year yield and any further inflation signals.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the risk they bring.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its -55.68% PnL and decay risk.
SPAL: Evaluate reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF due to its -36.82% PnL and decay.
NVDA: Watch the scanner entry 218.59-218.20 with stop 217.06 if you consider adding to chip exposure.
